name: Gaisen! Ichijiku Kanchou!
source:
Main character is appointed as a captain of a submarine with the only aim to avoid any crisis. However the vehicle gets hit by a torpedo of enemy submarine "Harukaze". Captain ignores commandment's orders and brilliantly uses has tactical skills and numerous inventions. For the glory of Japan!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公被任命为潜艇舰长，唯一任务就是避开一切危机。然而，潜艇却遭敌方潜艇“春风”号的鱼雷击中。舰长无视司令部命令，凭借出色的战术才能与众多发明巧妙应战。一切为了日本的荣耀！

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
